dedupe_keys.name: large scale topo rail segment line lgate 161

description: Large Scale Topo Rail Segment (Line) (LGATE-161) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. Topographic features whose primary characteristics relate to railway lines. Multiple points that describe a feature’s centreline or edge. NOTE: Landgate no longer maintains large scale topographic features. The large scale topographic data capture programme ceased in 2016. Please consider carefully the suitability of the data within this service for your purpose. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are IndurdualRail, Railway, Tramway, cultural, largescale. It offers 9 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
